    - l: A 2D list (list of lists) which is the main grid to be modified.
    - x: An integer representing the x-coordinate offset for the sub-region.
    - y: An integer representing the y-coordinate offset for the sub-region.

    2. For each pair of indices `(i, j)`, sets the element at position `[i+size+x][j+size+y]` in the list `l` to the character '.'.
]

The function `center` is supposed to modify a given 2D list by setting a specified sub-region to white cells, which is part of constructing the level-N carpet.

The current specification incorrectly offsets the indices by `size`, which results in modifying the wrong region of the grid.
To repair the specification:
1. Correct the index calculation in the loop to `[i+x][j+y]` instead of `[i+size+x][j+size+y]`.
2. Ensure the function correctly modifies the specified sub-region to white cells.
